topMovers.vulnerabilityName: BeyondTrust Remote Support Authentication Bypass by Spoofing Vulnerability
topMovers.shortDescription: BeyondTrust Remote Support contains an authentication bypass by spoofing vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to perform file operations on the appliance.

topMovers.vulnerabilityName: GitLab Community Edition and Enterprise Edition Integer Overflow or Wraparound Vulnerability
topMovers.shortDescription: GitLab Community Edition and Enterprise Edition contain a integer overflow or wraparound vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated user to execute arbitrary code on the GitLab server via a specially crafted regular expression in a CI/CD configuration, due to insufficient regular expression validation.

topMovers.vulnerabilityName: Adobe Commerce and Magento Improper Neutralization of Special Elements Used in a Template Engine Vulnerability
topMovers.shortDescription: Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source contain an improper neutralization of special elements used in a template engine vulnerability that could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code.

topMovers.vulnerabilityName: Plex Media Server Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) Vulnerability
topMovers.shortDescription: Plex Media Server contains a server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability that could allow an authenticated user to request arbitrary internal or external addresses via the '/video/:/transcode/universal' path parameter. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-96652, CVE-2026-96654, and CVE-2026-96656.

topMovers.vulnerabilityName: Plex Media Server Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) Vulnerability
topMovers.shortDescription: Plex Media Server contains a server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability which could allow an attacker using any X-Plex-Token value to include a full URL in the 'protocol' parameter and force the Plex server to POST to the attacker's chosen destination. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-96654, CVE-2026-96655, and CVE-2026-96656.

topMovers.vulnerabilityName: Trend Micro Apex One OS Command Injection Vulnerability
topMovers.shortDescription: Trend Micro Apex One Management Console (on-premise) contains an OS command injection vulnerability that could allow a pre-authenticated remote attacker to upload malicious code and execute commands on affected installations.

topMovers.vulnerabilityName: Cisco Secure Email Gateway SQL Injection Vulnerability
topMovers.shortDescription: Cisco AsyncOS software for Cisco Secure Email Gateway (SEG) contains a SQL injection vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to execute arbitrary commands with root privileges on the underlying operating system.

topMovers.product: Privileged Remote Access (PRA) and Remote Support (RS)
topMovers.vulnerabilityName: BeyondTrust Privileged Remote Access (PRA) and Remote Support (RS) OS Command Injection Vulnerability
topMovers.shortDescription: BeyondTrust Privileged Remote Access (PRA) and Remote Support (RS) contain an OS command injection vulnerability that can be exploited by an attacker with existing administrative privileges to upload a malicious file. Successful exploitation of this vulnerability can allow a remote attacker to execute underlying operating system commands within the context of the site user.

topMovers.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows Print Spooler Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
topMovers.shortDescription: Microsoft Windows Print Spooler contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows an attacker to gain SYSTEM-level privileges.

topMovers.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Update Notification Manager Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
topMovers.shortDescription: Microsoft Update Notification Manager contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation.

highestSignals.vulnerabilityName: WordPress WordPress Core Time-of-check Time-of-use (TOCTOU) Race Condition Vulnerability
highestSignals.shortDescription: WordPress WordPress Core contains a time-of-check time-of-use (TOCTOU) race condition vulnerability that could allow unauthenticated attackers to execute code on the server during the upgrade window. This is due to predictable, web-accessible staging paths used during full-package core upgrades.

highestSignals.vulnerabilityName: Ivanti Connect Secure Missing Authentication for Critical Function Vulnerability
highestSignals.shortDescription: Ivanti Connect Secure contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability that could allow a local authenticated attacker to escalate their privileges. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-104935 and CVE-2026-118527.

highestSignals.vulnerabilityName: Apple Multiple Products Improper Authentication Vulnerability
highestSignals.shortDescription: Apple iOS, iPadOS, macOS, Safari, tvOS and watchOS 10.5 contain an improper authentication vulnerability which could allow an attacker with arbitrary read and write capability to bypass pointer authentication.

highestSignals.vulnerabilityName: Ivanti Connect Secure Generation of Predictable Numbers or Identifiers Vulnerability
highestSignals.shortDescription: Ivanti Connect Secure contains a generation of predictable numbers or identifiers vulnerability that allows a remote authenticated attacker to upload files with attacker-controlled content to a known location on disk. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-104935 and CVE-2026-111357.
